newsitem.title: USA: Delta Mills Inc to sell $150 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Delta Mills Inc to sell $150 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: Delta Mills Inc plans to sell $150 million in 10-year senior notes in a 144a private placement via NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc, according to a confidential preliminary offering memorandum obtained by Reuters.
Delta Mills, based in Greenville, S.C., manufactures woven and knitted cotten, synthetic and blended fabrics used for apparel, home furnishings and other products.
The company is a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Delta Woodside Industries Inc.
Proceeds from the deal will be used to repay existing indebtedness, according to the prospectus.
